description:
I’m Sarthak, an Engineering Admission Counsellor known for clear, strategic, and student-first guidance across Maharashtra.
I help students not just choose colleges and branches, but build the right admission strategy using CAP rounds planning, cutoff analysis, and smart option filling.
My approach is honest, data-driven, and realistic, focused on long-term outcomes rather than short-term pressure.
I aim to give students clarity, confidence, and control over their engineering admission journey—making the process smooth and stress-free from start to finish.
